topics.name: REST Instances
topics.purpose: Define REST services with the same stable named-instance model as nanoCMS, separating logical identity, configurable port/listen binding and runtime lifecycle.

semantics.identity_rule: REST instance has stable logical name independent of port.
semantics.port_rule: REST port is configurable; no universal default REST port is defined here.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Declared REST configuration is separate from running state.
semantics.exposure_rule: REST exposes canonical operations/data surfaces and does not create new domain semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: REST reachability does not grant operation/data authority.
semantics.multiplicity_rule: Multiple named REST instances may coexist subject to valid bindings.

invariants.rule: Web instances, protocol bindings and exposed surfaces retain explicit stable identity, binding, lifecycle and authority boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: REST port treated as semantic identity
default REST port invented without canonical definition
REST endpoint creates hidden domain semantics

references.purpose: REST runtime follows canonical named service semantics.
